name: BOE Technology Group Company Limited
summary: BOE Technology Group Company Limited, a global Internet of Things (IoT) enterprise established in Beijing, China, in 1993, specializes in delivering advanced intelligent interface products and professional services. These offerings are designed to enhance information interaction and support human well-being across the globe. The company's diverse operations are organized into key segments: Display, IoT Innovation, Sensor and Application Solutions, Mini LED, and Smart Medicine & Engineering. In its Display division, BOE leverages sophisticated technologies such as TFT-LCD, AMOLED Oxide, and Microdisplay. These are integrated into a vast array of products, spanning consumer electronics like smartphones, tablets, laptops, monitors, and televisions, to specialized applications including vehicle displays, electronic shelf labels, tiled screens, industrial control systems, wearable and VR/AR devices, electronic tags, white goods, healthcare equipment, mobile payment systems, and interactive whiteboards. This segment also develops smart terminal products, such as tablets, low-power devices, IoT-specific displays, and 3D displays, complemented by integrated design and manufacturing services for system solutions. BOE's IoT innovation business provides comprehensive hardware and software solutions customized for sectors like smart finance, intelligent park management, government services, transportation, energy, and urban lighting. The Sensor and Application Solutions segment focuses on critical areas including medical biological detection, transportation and construction, consumer electronics, microwave communications, and industrial sensing. Here, BOE excels in designing and manufacturing sensor devices and offering complete system solutions, featuring products such as flat panel X-ray detectors, digital microfluidic chips, PDLC glass, fingerprint identification systems, and various industrial sensors. Furthermore, BOE is a significant provider of Mini-LED backlight and display products. Under its Smart Medicine & Engineering arm, the company is dedicated to advancing digital hospitals, offering holistic health management services, and developing technology-driven healthcare solutions. This includes an IoT platform specifically for smart health management, covering a full spectrum of health services from prevention and treatment to therapy and nursing.
